sim.links: same floor only; a device outside the floor outline has no link

cold.sources: address rotation about 15 min: docs/research/android_ble_models.md section 7; silent fractions and p_multi are assumptions

throw.credit: throw model copied from Sandtable's Scout (scout/scene.py)

noise_model.text: see the beacon/sim.py module docstring (stated model); radio constants: models.DEFAULT_NOISE

pipeline: beacon.track.PhoneTrack (median of the last UWB ranges, mean RSSI, hysteresis) -> beacon.locate.estimate
title: SIMULATED: phone locating with two boards on one device vs separate pucks
questions: (a) two boards rigidly 0.1, 0.3, 0.5 m apart on ONE thrown device, phone 2 to 8 m away in the fire room
(b) two separate pucks 2, 3, 4 m apart near the door
(c) reference: three separate pucks; one puck plus the phone's bearing

definitions.bearing_err_deg: angle between the true direction device-centre -> phone and the locator's pair bearing (debug.pair_bearing_deg), after resolving to the nearer of it and its mirror (pair_bearing_alt_deg)
definitions.mirror_ambiguity_rate: share of trials whose published geometry keeps both sides (candidates or ring)
definitions.mirror_wrong_side_rate: share of trials whose preferred side (more posterior mass) is the mirror of the truth
definitions.cross_range_m: true distance x sin(resolved bearing error)
definitions.cross_range_point_m: error of the published point (fix, or the nearest candidate) perpendicular to the true direction
definitions.tri_bearing_err_deg: same as bearing_err_deg, from plain trilateration on the median range of each board (independent of the locator)
definitions.uninformed_bearing_err_deg: reference with no range information: the guess 'straight out from the device' (perpendicular to the baseline), scored the same way; a bearing error near it carries no information (the room around the device already limits the directions)
definitions.twin_single_rate: of the trials where twin-off published two sides (candidates or ring), the share where twin-on published one fix (paired)
definitions.noise sweep: white sigma 0.05 / 0.10 m x static link bias 0 / 0.05 / 0.10 m, body block off (for two boards on one device a body block is common to both links, which a per-link model cannot represent); 'default' = models.DEFAULT_NOISE with body blocks; locator told the same noise (matched)
definitions.bearing arms: U1 phone pointed at the nearest visible puck (aim error 20 deg), default noise only
